create_flatmap_immutable_mapping: create a FlatMap immutable mapping from a dict for O(1) JAX tree flatten operations
convert_to_immutable_dict: convert a nested dict mapping to an immutable FlatMap using to_immutable_dict
convert_to_mutable_dict: convert an immutable FlatMap back to a mutable nested dict using to_mutable_dict
use_stack_context_manager: use a Stack as a context manager to push and pop elements with automatic cleanup
create_frozendict_hashable_mapping: create a frozendict hashable immutable mapping from key value pairs for use as dict keys
